3. Discharge Procedures

Discharge planning begins at admission. The care team will provide a discharge summary, prescription list, and follow-up appointment schedule at least 24 hours before anticipated discharge, where clinically feasible.

Patients arriving for emergency care are triaged immediately by clinical staff; administrative registration may be completed after initial stabilization.

Required documents at admission:

Photo identification (passport, driver's license, or Aadhaar card)

Insurance card or pre-authorization letter

Referral letter from primary physician, if applicable

List of current medications and known allergies

Patients or their designated representatives must settle outstanding billing at the Billing Counter (Ground Floor, Counter 4) prior to physical discharge. Payment plans are available for approved cases — contact the Financial Counseling Office.

Standard discharge time is 11:00 AM. Late discharge (after 6:00 PM) may incur an additional day's room charge unless waived by the attending physician for medical reasons.



4. Patient Rights & Grievance Redressal

Grievances regarding care quality, billing disputes, or staff conduct may be submitted in writing to the Patient Relations Office (Room 112, Administrative Wing) or via the feedback form available at every nursing station. All grievances are acknowledged within 48 hours and resolved within 10 working days.
